NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (Sample for Product Readiness UAT)

This Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of 15 March 2026
between:

Party A: Nyayasiddhi Demo Law Firm LLP, having its registered office at
New Delhi, India ("Disclosing Party")

Party B: Acme Corporate Services Inc., a company incorporated under the laws
of Delaware, USA ("Receiving Party")

1. PURPOSE
The parties wish to explore a potential commercial engagement relating to
legal technology services and document automation.

2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
"Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by either
party, including business plans, client lists, pricing, source code, and
legal opinions.

3. OBLIGATIONS
The Receiving Party shall (a) hold Confidential Information in strict confidence,
(b) not disclose it to third parties without prior written consent, and
(c) use it solely for the Purpose.

4. TERM
This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of three (3) years from the
Effective Date.

5. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Courts at New Delhi
shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

6. STATUTES REFERENCED
Indian Contract Act, 1872; Information Technology Act, 2000.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have executed this Agreement.

Signed: Rajesh Kumar (Disclosing Party)
Signed: Jane Smith (Receiving Party)
Court: High Court of Delhi (for dispute resolution clause reference)
Case Number: WP(C) 1234/2026 (illustrative only)
Filing Date: 2026-03-15
